candidates.title: Piroptose e progressão da doença inflamatória intestinal: coorte prospectiva
candidates.abstract: Este estudo de coorte prospectiva acompanhou 120 pacientes com doença inflamatória intestinal. A piroptose foi avaliada por marcadores séricos de gasdermina D. Pacientes com níveis elevados apresentaram progressão significativamente mais rápida da doença.

candidates.title: Pyroptosis and progression of inflammatory bowel disease: a prospective cohort
candidates.abstract: This prospective cohort study followed 120 patients with inflammatory bowel disease. Pyroptosis was assessed by serum gasdermin D markers. Patients with elevated levels showed significantly faster disease progression.

candidates.title: ピロプトーシスと炎症性腸疾患の関連
candidates.abstract: 本抄録は日本語データベースの索引抄録である。ピロプトーシス（pyroptosis）関連の腸炎症例が要約されている。全文は未収録で、原著の所在と版本は未確認。

candidates.title: Gasdermin D pores drive intestinal epithelial cell death in colitis models
candidates.abstract: We show that gasdermin D pores mediate intestinal epithelial cell death in two murine colitis models. Inhibition of pyroptotic pore formation (GSDMD inhibition) reduced epithelial injury scores.

candidates.title: 细胞焦亡在肠道炎症中的作用及机制研究
candidates.abstract: 本研究探讨细胞焦亡在肠道炎症中的作用及机制。结果提示细胞焦亡相关通路激活与炎症性肠病活动度相关，为跨语言检索提供了中文原始研究证据。
